item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "dbd60e1ba2e2d770285942d5a3c1d26040410ef412653ec041e22f00d0f605a8",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For fields q and production valued in a real normed vector space and a map flux, requires interval integrability of every spatial slice of q, every temporal slice of flux composed with q, every spatial slice of production, and every temporal function obtained by spatially integrating production. It also requires, for all real a,b,s,t, that the spatial integral of q at t minus that at s equal the time integral of flux(q(a,τ)) minus flux(q(b,τ)), plus the iterated production integral.",
      "effect_on_target": "This entire package is the hypothesis and is repeated as the first conclusion, with flux(v)=speed·v and values in Fin 1 → Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Requires interval integrability of all spatial slices of q and all temporal slices of flux composed with q, together with the identity that each spatial integral change equals the integrated left boundary flux minus right boundary flux, for all real endpoints.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the source-free integral balance property appearing positively and negatively in the two equivalences. It includes integrability, not just an equality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited addition and zero for constructing the real scalar action; adds no hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures that real scalar multiplication on a real coordinate is ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies multiplication by speed on each real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all five main conclusions simultaneously and all clauses of each local definition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real self-algebra and its scalar multiplication without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Constructs a nontrivially normed field from a densely normed field while retaining its normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar-field structure required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a monoid action from an action that distributes over addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in the inherited scalar action used for continuity and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real semiring operations required by module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All displayed integral equalities are equalities in the function space Fin 1 → Real, hence equality of the single real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an element satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts the existence of a joint quadruple of real endpoints a,b,s,t with nonzero iterated production integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring, inverse, division, and associated structure as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited real scalar algebra; imposes no additional restriction on speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Filter.Eventually",
      "meaning": "The set of points satisfying a predicate belongs to the specified filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "With the almost-everywhere filter, makes the derivative assertion hold outside a measure-zero set of times.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "The finite type of natural numbers strictly less than its natural-number parameter.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 has the single index 0, so states have exactly one real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all elements of Fin n using finRange n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies finiteness of the singleton coordinate index for the function-space norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts a scalar action to functions by applying it pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "For a state v, (speed·v)(0)=speed·v(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Selects the addition operation of a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here adds states pointwise, including the boundary contribution and production integral in the derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Selects the scalar multiplication operation of a heterogeneous scalar-action instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the fixed linear flux v ↦ speed·v.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Selects the subtraction operation of a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the ordered differences: final minus initial spatial integral and left minus right flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at a point, using the neighborhood filter at that point and that point as the fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts an ordinary real-variable, vector-valued derivative of the spatial integral at almost every time, not merely a formal derivative value or a weak derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, asserting implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the zero-integral characterization and the nonzero-witness characterization are bidirectional.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector-space structure from an inner-product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real coordinate's normed-space structure used in vector integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology gives continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the real scalar action needed by the derivative definition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has the corresponding topological semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers continuity of real ring operations into the scalar-action construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring has a module topology when regarded as a module over itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of real multiplication as a scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "The type of measures on a specified measurable space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the measure object used for both interval integrals and almost-everywhere quantification.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on arbitrary sets through its underlying outer measure, with values in the extended nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the measure-zero condition for exceptional sets meaningful.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instOuterMeasureClass",
      "meaning": "Measures satisfy the outer-measure interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the almost-everywhere filter to be constructed from the selected real measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the measurable-space structure from a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measurable structure associated with the selected real volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every integral and exceptional-set condition uses the same distinguished measure on Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.ae",
      "meaning": "The filter of sets whose complements have outer measure zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "For each fixed a,b, the derivative assertion may fail only on a set of times of measure zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the inherited real scalar action used in the derivative's function-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts associative multiplication from a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-action instance chain without changing real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative monoid for scalar actions; zero remains a permitted scalar.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action used for continuity of multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the dimension parameter 1 for Fin 1 and numeral infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The existential witness must have an iterated production integral unequal to the zero state; no positivity is asserted.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital commutative ring operations in a structure that does not require associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring instance chain without altering operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital, nonassociative ring structure, dropping the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the algebraic interface for real topological-ring continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid from a nonunital, nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero to the module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital commutative ring structure of a normed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real ring operations to the continuity-instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring structure from its commutative version.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the norm and operations underlying the real coordinate space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive norm structure needed for real normed-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts a nonunital semiring structure without requiring associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of real addition for the module instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real norm and field operations used in differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's norm, metric, and ring operations while omitting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring construction without modifying the topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, ring operations, and underlying pseudometric as a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real seminormed structures used by the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real algebraic operations to scalar and module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's norm, metric, and commutative ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the normed ring structure underlying real scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides scalar multiplication and its algebraic laws for the derivative's codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Not",
      "meaning": "Logical negation, defined as implication to falsehood.",
      "effect_on_target": "Negates the entire source-free balance package in the fourth conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number numeral using the selected numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 1 as the coordinate count and 0 as the zero state where appropriate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Gives a function space a module structure through pointwise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin 1 → Real a real vector space for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a dependent function space the pointwise commutative additive group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the state-space addition, subtraction, and additive inverses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines function addition by (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "All additions of states and integral values are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.instSub",
      "meaning": "Defines function subtraction by (f−g)(i)=f(i)−g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "All state and integral differences are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function takes value zero at every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The zero in the production-integral characterizations is the zero element of the one-coordinate state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed commutative additive groups with its product normed additive group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed state space for integrals; with one real coordinate this is the usual one-dimensional real normed space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed vector spaces with the pointwise module structure and compatible norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows real vector-valued integration in Fin 1 → Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology induced by all coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative's state-space topology is the ordinary topology of its single real coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real metric to the topology used for differentiation and scalar continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips an RCLike field with a real inner-product space structure and its associated real normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "For Real, supplies the ordinary real normed-space structure on each state coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Space, time, interval endpoints, speed, and each state coordinate are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field with the property that norms attain values between any two positive bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a nontrivially normed real scalar field for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Underlies real and coordinatewise state addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The commutative additive group structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the pointwise additive group on states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports Real as an algebra over itself and hence multiplication by speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The RCLike structure on Real, with real-part map the identity, imaginary-part map zero, and its complete normed real self-algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real normed-space structures; introduces no complex-valued states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real addition and multiplication used by module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction defined as addition of the negative.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the signs of spatial integral changes and boundary flux differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the zero coordinate of the zero state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The selected measure-space instance on Real. The supplied body is only inferInstance and does not expose the selected measure or its normalization.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measure μ for all integrability, integrals, and almost-everywhere assertions. The translation can be exact in terms of μ; identifying it independently as normalized Lebesgue measure requires an expansion not supplied here.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group equipped with its real norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate norm used to integrate and differentiate states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group and real commutative ring with the norm multiplication bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible real algebra and norm structures throughout the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual norm and metric, including multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the normed scalar field for state-space integration and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric given by distance |x−y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes temporal differentiation use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure on Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real self-module topology and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies inherited real semiring operations in the module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a semifield's division-semiring operations and laws without requiring multiplicative commutativity in the resulting interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-field instance chain without changing the real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate scalar operation used in the continuous function-space action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, pseudometric, and commutative ring operations while omitting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real seminormed additive group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and metric used to obtain the scalar topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar topology used by continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains semiring multiplication, one, zero, and their monoid-with-zero laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the multiplicative scalar structure, including the allowed scalar zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of real additive operations for modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual topology of real coordinates and scalars.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
